question: White t - shirts can be purchased in packages of 13. If mom buys 39 white t - shirts How many packages will she have?

baseline.generated_text:
To find out how many packages of white t-shirts mom can buy, we need to divide the total number of t-shirts by the number of t-shirts per package.

Number of t-shirts per package = 13
Total number of t-shirts = 39

Number of packages = Total number of t-shirts / Number of t-shirts per package
= 39 / 13
= 3

So, mom can buy 3 packages of white t-shirts.
